messages:
clara_pm: Quick sync — we need to nail Q3 hosted-api scope for embeddings + rerank micro-SLOs for the enterprise search POC. Customer targets: p95 embeddings <= 120ms (single req), rerank median <= 80ms for 5-doc reranks. Budget: ~$20k/mo hosted. Need canary gating and rollback conditions. Thoughts?

arun_rt: Are those SLOs realistic on current prod kernels? We'll need warm KV cache and batching tuned for short requests.

sam_eng: Quick back-of-napkin: on g5-like hosts with m-embed-v2 q4 we can hit p95 ~110ms at steady <3 req/s. Degrades with bursts. Autoscale + burst policy required.

maya: FYI customer will have 20 req/s spikes for search events. They expect stable p95 during spikes, not just steady state.

pete: Let's define canary gating: p95 < 130ms for 1h under 5-10 rps and accuracy drift < 0.5% vs baseline. If either fails -> immediate rollback.

rachel: How do we measure accuracy drift? Use Hugo's eval harness against customer's sample set. Also add token-cost regression threshold (<10%).

jon: Recommend monitoring bundle: p50/p95 latency, throughput, error rate, cost per 1k tokens, rerank MRR/ndcg delta. Example canary config: ```
canary:
  duration: 60m
  traffic: 5%
  traffic_profile: burst=10rps
  p95_latency_threshold_ms: 130
  error_rate_threshold: 0.5%
  accuracy_delta_threshold: 0.5
```

deploy-bot: Canary will run automatically when rollout configured. I will post progress and auto-rollback if alert fires.

arun_rt: Add autoscale policy: min_replicas:2, scale_step:2, cooldown:90s. Also enable prefix caching for embedding reuse.

sam_eng: I'll run a simulated traffic run next week with the load harness. Need representative prompt set + rerank candidate distributions from customer.

clara_pm: Action items: sam -> run sim and post numbers by Tue; rachel -> collect customer eval set; arun -> draft canary + autoscale config; pete -> cost guardrails and pricing note. Sync Thu.

maya: Confirming customer ok with 5% canary traffic initially. They'll provide sample payloads.

pete: :thumbsup: I'll draft cost scenarios. If p95 spikes during bursts propose fallback to smaller model (m-embed-v1) — need policy for automatic downgrade.

rachel: Add observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency histograms, rerank quality alert tied to eval baseline.

jon: Edge case: cold-cache on new corpora -> expected p95 spike. Add 'cold-cache' label in metrics and exclude those windows from canary gating for first 30m.

arun_rt: Implementation detail: set cache TTL 24h for embeddings; plan to pre-warm top 100k host docs for the POC.

clara_pm: For launch criteria (draft): 1) Simulated runs meet SLOs across 2/3 traffic profiles; 2) Eval set quality delta <= 0.5%; 3) Cost per 1k tokens within budget; 4) Canary + rollback policy in place + live dashboard. Any objections?

maya: No objections. One extra ask: include SOC2/PII note — POC will require KMS and clear data handling assurances.

pete: We will add a KMS line item and private deployment guidance to the one-pager.

rachel: I'll prepare a customer-facing one-pager outlining SLOs, canary criteria, and fallback plan.

clara_pm: Thanks all. Looping legal for data terms offline. Meeting Thu 10am — invite sent.
